changes.text: 对富兰克林动议的签署格式表决：新罕布什尔、马萨诸塞、康涅狄格、新泽西、宾夕法尼亚、特拉华、马里兰、弗吉尼亚、北卡罗来纳、佐治亚10个州赞成，南卡罗来纳代表团意见分裂。据麦迪逊注，平克尼和巴特勒因不喜欢这一含糊的签署格式而投了反对票。

On Franklin's motion for the signing form, ten states voted ay: New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Connecticut, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, North Carolina and Georgia. South Carolina was divided. Madison notes that Pinckney and Butler disliked the equivocal form of signing and on that account voted in the negative.
最后，除伦道夫、梅森、格里三人外，所有成员都签了字，会议随即无期休会。最后几人签字时，富兰克林望着主席椅背上画着的一轮初升的太阳，对身边几位成员说，画家很难在画里分清朝阳与落日：“会期之中，随着我对结果时而希望、时而担心，我一次又一次地望着主席身后那个太阳，却分不出它是在升起还是在落下；如今，我终于欣慰地知道，那是一轮升起的太阳，而不是落下的。”

In the end every member signed except Randolph, Mason and Gerry, who declined to give the Constitution the sanction of their names; the convention then dissolved itself by an adjournment sine die, without naming a day to return. While the last members were signing, Franklin looked toward the president's chair, at the back of which a rising sun happened to be painted, and remarked to the few members near him that painters had found it difficult in their art to tell a rising sun from a setting one. "I have," said he, "often and often, in the course of the session, and the vicissitudes of my hopes and fears as to its issue, looked at that behind the president, without being able to tell whether it was rising or setting; but now, at length, I have the happiness to know that it is a rising, and not a setting sun."

dispositions.rationale: 在中英文末尾补充麦迪逊脚注，说明南卡罗来纳代表团分裂的原因：平克尼和巴特勒反对的是含糊的签署格式，并非宪法本身。ev 增补了 F-E25。

evidence.quote: Gen. Pinckney and Mr. Butler disliked the equivocal form of signing, and on that account voted in the negative.

dispositions.rationale: 按麦迪逊记录恢复“初升的太阳”这一细节，英文改为 a rising sun。中文统一称“主席椅背”，与同段“主席身后”保持一致。其余文字未动。

evidence.quote: at the back of which a rising sun happened to be painted
